input_manifest.text:
Momcozy V2 Pro Wearable Breast Pump,Electric Breast Pump for Pumping Moms

Powerful Yet Ultra-Lightweight—Momcozy V2 Pro's Motor provides powerful suction of 288mmHg for efficient and rapid breast emptying. Its compact pocket-size design (only 0.28lb) ensures convenient portability.
Customized Settings - 3 Modes (Stimulation | Expression | Mixed modes) & 9 Levels, allowing mothers to easily find a comfortable setting that meets their current breastfeeding needs.
Pump As If No One Knows - The teardrop-shaped milk collector (each 120g/0.26lb) easily conceals within the bra and is controlled through the handheld motor. Operating at a whisper-quiet 45dB, rest assured that your baby's peaceful nap remains undisturbed while you pump.

—— 来源（美国站）：https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CZNTCFXX

【待读的链接】
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CZNTCFXX

risk_items.risk_type: 平台与促销-静音绝对化表述
risk_items.risk_category_basis: 类别「平台与促销」⇒ 合规（软判（按 §6.2/§5.2 语义归类）：PRD §7.1 外部标准库含「平台政策」）
risk_items.reason: 逐字命中「quiet」：H02 催乳/增产/奶量产出承诺（含裸 more milk、催产素、长期奶量、裸奶阵/排空功效claim，无 FDA/临床证据）；放松叙事+限定语（natural let-down/may help）走 M07 语境守卫；M01 静音程度夸大（建议改为 low noise / quiet mode）（p_level=P0 risk_level=Critical authority=None，来源表 None）
risk_items.suggestion: 记录级改法：静音表述改客观参数（as low as 48 dB），避免 whisper/silent/ultra-quiet 绝对化
